Side projection of lower leg; red is removed only within the inner X band.
World Y increasing right; floor Z = 0. View clipped at Z = 241.7.
X increases right; inner face faces board center.
Cut from inner side, open through foot end, to horizontal shoulder Z = 141.7 above floor.
Runner top Z = 139.7; shoulder gap = 2. Shoulder bearing is not credited.
Transverse clearance = 0. Preserve the full opposite-face leg thickness.
Matching bolt axes: bolt-member-datums.csv and leg bolt sheet. Do not use the image as a drill template.
Kickers remain unnotched; original outer-post attachment axes retained. See panel-attachment-axes.csv.
